name: tracker-supervisor-worker-isolation
goal: A blocked adapter poll cannot delay other worker ticks, an individual worker cannot overlap itself, and cancellation drains all active ticks before SQLite closes.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: A slow adapter stalls subsequent notification/dispatch/recurrence passes because all workers are awaited by the same poll loop. Each worker must repeat independently and drain before close.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing supervisor run/status/shutdown case blocked the only worker and never required another worker to keep ticking. Strengthen it with a held adapter and repeated notifications.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At a7c95dc170 the committed test observed one notification tick while the adapter was blocked; expected more than one.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Run one non-overlapping poll loop per configured worker under the common lifetime and drain all workers before close.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
